# PR template

## What

Short description of the change.

## Why

The problem or improvement it addresses.

## How

Key implementation notes (files touched, approach).

## Manual test checklist

- [ ] Opened a real `.ipynb` and ran 3 cells (code + markdown + error)
- [ ] Search `Ctrl+F` works
- [ ] Export `.ipynb` + `.md` works
- [ ] Dark/light toggle works
- [ ] Popup + context menu paths work
- [ ] `manifest.json` version bumped (user-facing)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated

## Screenshots

UI changes: before/after.
